english.note: Use 合集 for a compiled collection of articles or online posts, especially when it is not a named digest magazine.

examples.english: This digest compiles the good articles we read online this week.
examples.traditional: 呢個合集整理咗我哋今個星期喺網上睇過嘅好文章。
